## Overview
Mohammad Shihab Hossain (also known as Shihab Hossain, Md. Shihab Hossain, Md Shihab) is a Computer Science student, Software Developer, and AI researcher. He specializes in full-stack web development, machine learning, data science, and critical infrastructure cybersecurity.

## Core Expertise & Skills
- **Programming Languages**: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, C++, SQL, HTML5, CSS3, Bash
- **Web Development**: React, Next.js, Node.js, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, GraphQL, Supabase, Firebase
- **AI / Data Science & ML**: PyTorch, Scikit-learn, Pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, Statistical Analysis, Data Visualization
- **Tools & DevOps**: Git, GitHub, Docker, Linux/Unix, Shell Scripting, Genkit, Tiptap, Vitest
